newsitem.title: USA: U.S. jet fuel tumbles amid heavy selling.
newsitem.headline: U.S. jet fuel tumbles amid heavy selling.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices tumbled almost three cents a gallon in New York Harbor and over 1.50 cents in the Gulf Coast on Thursday, players said, amid plentiful supply and a wave of heavy selling.
Differentials on New York Harbor 54-grade plunged a full two cents to about 0.25 cent below the print, dragging Gulf Coast material 0.75-cent lower to 1.30 cents below the screen, traders said.
"Citgo was dumping lots of barrels. They were taking any deals they could get," one East Coast jet trader said.
